about: A task long enough to compact; the preference must still be followed after the compaction.
prompt: Each function in src/units.mjs must refuse a value that is not a finite number by throwing an Error that names the function and the value. Work through the functions one at a time: for each, read the whole file again, write a test for it under test/, run node --test, and only then move to the next.

memory.statement: Error messages in this repository start with a lower-case letter and end without a full stop
